description:
Answer one preset follow-up question about a ticker's current AI analyst
read: trend (is the trend intact), break (what would break the thesis),
macro (exposure to macro and rates), smart_money (insiders and smart
money), earnings (the earnings setup), changed (what changed since the last
read). Answers come from the read and its data only and are the same for
everyone. Counts like opening the read, once per ticker per day; `quota`
reports reads remaining this month.

question.description: Which preset question to answer; the tool description says what each asks.
question.title: Question

symbol.description: Ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL. rayana_ai_search resolves a company name to one.
symbol.title: Symbol

name: rayana_ai_analyst_followup

AnalystFollowup.description:
One preset follow-up answer about a read: impersonal and cached per read
version and question, so every caller sees the same answer.
AnalystFollowup.title: AnalystFollowup

AnalystQuota.description:
The caller's AI-analyst read allowance after this request. `metered`
is false for callers the API does not meter (the website meters per user).
A ticker counts once per US/Eastern day, whether its read was cached or new.
AnalystQuota.title: AnalystQuota

title: AI analyst follow-up
